stopConditions: an Actions incident is open: do not dispatch
the dispatch command fails: record and stop; no retry
no job allocated within 30 minutes: apply queueTimeout and stop

startup_failure or no job allocation recurs while the provider is healthy and the tag is intact: record request IDs, open a GitHub Support case and stop; the result then points at a workflow- or account-side cause

queueTimeout.rule: if no job is allocated within 30 minutes of run creation, record the run as not-allocated with its run, attempt and job inventories
queueTimeout.cancellation: cancelling the stuck run is a mutation; the owner authorization must state whether the agent may cancel it, otherwise it is left queued and reported
queueTimeout.attemptAccounting: a dispatched run consumes the single authorized attempt whether or not a job is allocated; there is no automatic second dispatch
queueTimeout.rationale: the 43 runs from the 2026-11-11 window never left queued, so waiting without a bound is not a terminal outcome
